header.clarity_source: Google Sheet history tab, 30 daily pulls through the InsightfulPipe MCP (2026-09-28 to 2026-10-27)

fix_details.evidence: 225 of 3,354 Clarity sessions on /signup/ (6.7%) had a JavaScript error, 5.7 times the site's 1.17%. Mobile 10.7%, PC 1.1%.
fix_details.estimate: 3,900 GA4 sessions × 6.7% × 30.26% (1,180 sign-ups ÷ 3,900 sessions that viewed the page) = 79.2 sign-ups in 30 days (estimate).
fix_details.recordings_to_watch: Recordings > Filters > Page > JavaScript errors: the top error on this page; Path > Visited URL: contains /signup/; User info > Device: Mobile; Time frame: Last 30 days. Watch 5 to 10 and note what the visitor tried just before the signal.
fix_details.heatmap_view: Heatmaps > /signup/ > Click maps, with the same filter
fix_details.check_after_fix: JavaScript errors share on /signup/ on Mobile in the next 14 days of history, against 6.7% now.
fix_details.likely_cause: From your notes (6 recordings): On iPhones the Create account button does nothing after the phone number is typed with spaces. The error in Clarity is a phone formatting error from the phone input script, right after the tap.
fix_details.what_to_do: Fix the phone formatting error in the phone input script on iOS Safari (accept spaces and dashes, or strip them before checking), then re-test sign-up on an iPhone.

fix_details.evidence: 336 of 8,256 Clarity sessions on /pricing/ (4.1%) had rage clicks, 2.9 times the site's 1.4%. Mobile 6.8%, PC 1.8%.
fix_details.estimate: 9,600 GA4 sessions × 4.1% × 7.4% (page converts at 7.4%, at or above the site's 2.14%) = 28.9 sign-ups in 30 days (estimate).
fix_details.recordings_to_watch: Recordings > Filters > User actions > Insights: Rage clicks; Path > Visited URL: contains /pricing/; User info > Device: Mobile; Time frame: Last 30 days. Watch 5 to 10 and note what the visitor tried just before the signal.
fix_details.heatmap_view: Heatmaps > /pricing/ > Click maps, with the same filter
fix_details.check_after_fix: Rage clicks share on /pricing/ on Mobile in the next 14 days of history, against 4.1% now.
fix_details.likely_cause: From your notes (8 recordings): Visitors tap the words Monthly and Yearly beside the billing switch. Only the small switch responds, so they tap the words three or four times, then scroll down without changing the prices.
fix_details.what_to_do: Make the words Monthly and Yearly part of the switch (one tap target around both labels and the switch), and show the price change right away.
fix_details.speed: Mobile LCP 2.4 s, Total Blocking Time 280 ms: not slow enough to explain the clicks.

fix_details.evidence: 882 of 10,148 Clarity sessions on /blog/reduce-no-shows/ (8.7%) had excessive scrolling, 2.5 times the site's 3.51%. Mobile 9.7%, PC 6.3%.
fix_details.estimate: 11,800 GA4 sessions × 8.7% × 1.74% (site 2.14% minus page 0.4%) = 17.8 sign-ups in 30 days (estimate).
fix_details.recordings_to_watch: Recordings > Filters > User actions > Insights: Excessive scrolling; Path > Visited URL: contains /blog/reduce-no-shows/; User info > Device: Mobile; Time frame: Last 30 days. Watch 5 to 10 and note what the visitor tried just before the signal.
fix_details.heatmap_view: Heatmaps > /blog/reduce-no-shows/ > Scroll maps, with the same filter
fix_details.check_after_fix: Excessive scrolling share on /blog/reduce-no-shows/ on Mobile in the next 14 days of history, against 8.7% now.
fix_details.likely_cause: Watch first. The two most likely causes: visitors hunting for one answer in a long page with no jump links; or the call to action sits far from where the reader decides.
fix_details.what_to_do: Watch the recordings below, confirm which cause it is, then fix that element.
fix_details.note: This page has the most flagged sessions in the fix list (882) but ranks here, because it converts at 0.4% and only the gap to the site rate is at stake.

fix_details.evidence: 345 of 3,698 Clarity sessions on /industries/salons/ (9.3%) had dead clicks, 1.6 times the site's 5.9%. Mobile 11.1%, PC 5.9%.
fix_details.estimate: 4,300 GA4 sessions × 9.3% × 3.6% (page converts at 3.6%, at or above the site's 2.14%) = 14.4 sign-ups in 30 days (estimate).
fix_details.recordings_to_watch: Recordings > Filters > User actions > Insights: Dead clicks; Path > Visited URL: contains /industries/salons/; User info > Device: Mobile; Time frame: Last 30 days. Watch 5 to 10 and note what the visitor tried just before the signal.
fix_details.heatmap_view: Heatmaps > /industries/salons/ > Click maps, with the same filter
fix_details.check_after_fix: Dead clicks share on /industries/salons/ on Mobile in the next 14 days of history, against 9.3% now.
fix_details.likely_cause: Watch first. The two most likely causes: images or cards styled like links that open nothing; or a slow script, so taps land before the page can respond.
fix_details.what_to_do: Fix mobile speed first (Total Blocking Time 720 ms, LCP 4.6 s), then watch the recordings to see whether the dead clicks remain.
fix_details.speed: Mobile LCP 4.6 s, Total Blocking Time 720 ms: fix speed first.
